eeg.role: per-channel instrument floor (electrode impedance, amplifier noise)

bold.role: per-region instrument floor (scanner and physiological noise)
bold.warning: bold.log_noise is exactly its -4.0 initialisation across every region with zero spread: it never received a gradient. No BOLD likelihood from this head is fitted, and none may be reported as if it were.

anatomical_prior.notes: Topology regulariser only. Hard anatomical constraints stay compiled; soft constraints update only within their priors (body.tex 6.4). n_eff = 1: one group-average object, not 207 subjects -- the subjects were averaged away.

eegmmidb_real.notes: Scalp EEG during rest, real and imagined movement. Single site, single montage, no individual head models: supports population-level EEG prediction claims only. 290,673 windows on disk; the leakage-audited split is 189,765/29,238/71,670 windows over 71/11/27 of the 109 participants (train_main.log lines 22, 126-129).

montage_calibration.notes: Per-channel gain/offset/noise nuisance for the EEG head. Its mask is contained in eegmmidb_real's, which is what makes it admissible at tier 2 rather than a second founding source.

negative_control_shuffled.notes: Amplitude-matched, phase-randomised surrogates of the real EEG windows.

sim_wholebrain.notes: Delayed connectome-coupled neural-mass SDEs (Wilson-Cowan, Jansen-Rit, reduced Wong-Wang, Stuart-Landau, linear Gaussian). 37 shards, 37,888 trajectories, 454,656 trajectory-seconds, 49 GB, fast tier only. Generated on the SYNTHETIC ellipsoid connectome (index_fast.json anatomy.provenance = synthetic_fallback, 454 regions), not on the 414-parcel ENIGMA/HCP prior: the shapes differ, so adopting the real prior requires regenerating the corpus. 40.69 % of it carries no anatomy-derived regional timescale (as generated).

sleepedf_real.notes: Blocked on a montage adapter, not on data: 7.60 GB and 78 participants are on disk. Until the adapter exists, no G5 individualisation claim is evaluable on any source in this mixture (eegmmidb has one session per participant).

tribe_v2_teacher.notes: Discrepancy-inflated interface regulariser only. Enabling it requires Ramon's teacher-vs-measured discrepancy measurement first; no such measurement exists in reports/ as of 2026-08-06.

schedule.note: sync points are exact in integer nanoseconds; a runtime that accumulates t += dt in floating point will drift against this plan
